question: Theyyam is the ritual art form of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kerela**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

__
 
• In** Kerala and Karnataka, theyyam** is a prominent **ritual style of dance worship.**
 
• Theyyam is made up of thousands of years of **traditions, ceremonies, and customs**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Theyyam is a kind of Hinduism **that indigenous groups have practised since time immemorial.
 
• It includes dance, mime, and music.
 
• It extols the beliefs of ancient tribals who placed a high value on the worship of heroes and the spirits of their ancestors.
